 Asset Description : 
 An overspeed protection relay is an electronic device designed to protect electrical equipment from damage due to overspeed conditions. It is typically used in high-speed machinery, such as wind turbines or jet engines. The overspeed protection relay consists of the following main components:

1. Overspeed sensor: Measures the speed of the machinery and converts it into an electrical signal.
2. Processing unit: Compares the measured speed with a predetermined limit and triggers the output circuit if the speed exceeds the limit.
3. Output circuit: Activates an alarm or shuts down the machinery if the speed exceeds the limit.
4. Power supply: Provides the electrical power to the relay.

The overspeed protection relay functions by continuously monitoring the speed of the machinery and triggering an alarm or shutdown if the speed exceeds a predetermined limit. This helps prevent damage to the machinery and ensures the safety of the operating personnel.
